$description: WCAG 2 contrast of every colour pair declared in v2/tools/contrast-pairs.json, written by v2/tools/audit-contrast.mjs. pass is decided on the unrounded ratio.

distinct.$description: delta_e_ok is the Euclidean distance in OKLab. Flags: "identical" at 0; "hard to tell apart" below 0.06 with normal vision or below 0.04 under any simulation. These thresholds are the lead's starting values, not a standard. Simulations: Machado, Oliveira and Fernandes 2009, severity 1.0, on linear RGB.
